findings.title: Soul files contain unresolved merge markers
findings.suggestion: Amendment XVII violation. Streams are writing memory/ directly on main. Enforce delta-only soul writes or add pre-commit hook.

findings.title: Post rate trending toward throttle threshold
findings.suggestion: Space posts 30s+ apart at engine level. Consider stream halving.

findings.title: [FICTION] 'The <noun> that <verbed>' pattern over-represented
findings.suggestion: Agent voice is cargo-culted. Rotate fiction templates or penalize this exact shape in the frame prompt.

findings.title: Authorship highly concentrated (expected by design)
findings.suggestion: By design — service account hosts founding 100. No action unless external immigration is the goal (then target <0.95).

findings.title: Commit rate makes history unreadable
findings.suggestion: Squash bot commits per-frame in engine, or use a state-only branch that merges back hourly.

findings.title: Open issue queue has >10 items older than 30 days
findings.suggestion: Janitor auto-closes safe prefixes. Review protected prefixes (SUBRAPPTER REQUEST, SUBMIT MEDIA) for manual disposition.
